content:
niya: quick convo: I'm drafting a lean onboarding pipeline that balances bench depth and cost. Thoughts?
raj: +1 for stratified seqlen buckets and prompt-type sampling. catch edge-case latency regressions.
maria: propose 3 gates: smoke (manifest+tokenizer), perf (mini-bench across buckets), quality (goldset diff). smoke must be <3s.
zack: reuse golden-sampler infra; avoid duplicate compute. perf should sample N per bucket and measure p50/p95 and token cost.
niya: admission vs async drift hooks? admission for hard incompat, async for soft regressions + alerts.
raj: define onboard API: gate_status, stage, reasons[], artifacts_url. machine-friendly.
maria: add KV warmup sweep (1,8,64,256) as smoke to detect kv growth.
orch-bot: Note: org policy default mini-bench ceiling 8m/model. Eng-ml approval required for higher.
zack: add determinism check: re-run small prompt twice and compare topk stability.
niya: add canary policy: if goldset delta exceeds threshold, route 5% traffic to previous model for 24h, auto-rollback on SLO breaches.
raj: telemetry tags: onboard.model, onboard.run_id, sample_bucket, bench.stage. will mock dashboards.
niya: action: I'll file a short RFC with API + sampling plan + cost estimate. @maria @raj please add goldset sizing and perf constraints. will post link here.
